scripts.web:build: cd web && npm install && npm run build
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test src/rules.test.ts src/app.test.ts src/http.test.ts src/guard-contract.test.ts src/guard-gate.test.ts src/preflight.test.ts src/ratelimit.test.ts src/privy.test.ts
scripts.demo:reset: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('demo.db',{force:true})" && cross-env DEMO=true DB_PATH=demo.db npm run seed
scripts.demo: cross-env DEMO=true DB_PATH=demo.db CRE_SHARED_SECRET=demo PORT=8787 tsx src/index.ts
scripts.cre:test: cd cre-workflow/guard-workflow && bun test && cd ../agent-workflow && bun test && cd ../board-workflow && bun test
scripts.cre:build: cd cre-workflow/guard-workflow && bun x cre-compile main.ts ../guard.wasm && cd ../agent-workflow && bun x cre-compile main.ts ../agent.wasm && cd ../board-workflow && bun x cre-compile main.ts ../board.wasm
scripts.cre:simulate: cd cre-workflow && cre workflow simulate guard-workflow --target staging-settings --non-interactive --trigger-index 0
scripts.cre:broadcast: cd cre-workflow && cre workflow simulate guard-workflow --target staging-settings --non-interactive --trigger-index 0 --broadcast
scripts.cre:install: cd cre-workflow/guard-workflow && bun install && cd ../agent-workflow && bun install && cd ../board-workflow && bun install
scripts.demo:reset:live: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('demo.db',{force:true})" && cross-env DEMO=true DEMO_PRICES=false DB_PATH=demo.db npm run seed
scripts.demo:live: cross-env DEMO=true DEMO_PRICES=false DRY_RUN=false DB_PATH=demo.db CRE_SHARED_SECRET=demo PORT=8787 tsx src/index.ts
